individual_admission.requirements: Require the complete original independently admitted individual effects and immutable archive, not selected winners or partial pilots. Retain all original stopped branches, control roles, failure histories, uncertainty and population limitations. No old frozen job/source/report is redirected.

hypothesis: Position-based sequence weights depend on alignment-column residue distributions. Legacy insertion projection can overwrite normalized source residues; a weighting effect measured on that geometry need not predict its effect on a residue-preserving MSA. Test the interaction directly, not an assumed sum of small benchmark gains. Both weighting policies and repair passed their original complete development screens, but their individual effects are mixed and OrthoBench intervals span zero. No superiority is assumed.
design: One bounded2x3 factorial OrthoBench pilot: projection legacy/residue_preserving by weighting none/henikoff/henikoff_cluster. Four exact constituent controls precede two new candidate combinations. These are combinations of unchanged surviving policies, not retuning of failed branches.
implementation_contract: Keep defaults weighting=none, projection=legacy and alignment=off unchanged. Expose only the two explicitly registered weighting/repair combinations through existing opt-in API/CLI/replay policies. Preserve fresh built-in high_sensitivity scope checks. Species-balanced weighting with repair, any alignment-guard combination and selective-reselection combinations remain unsupported in public inference/replay.

Use structured per-arm parameters, never derive scientific policies by slicing arm labels. Preserve old experiment modes and all frozen sources. Lower-level profile construction already has separate weighting/projection inputs; do not rewrite scoring, clustering or reconciliation to enable the joint option.

Build weights from the actual repaired MSA. Preserve each policy's established normalization, fixed0.62 cluster effective count, historical match-mask rule applied to that MSA, pseudocounts, transitions, insert emissions, candidate prefilter and strict source-member/sequence-anchor decision rules. Recompute self thresholds from each arm's actual profiles; never borrow constituent thresholds.

Serial/spawn workers and any existing jackknife rebuild preserve both selected policies. Record actual per-profile construction/weighting policies and effective counts, plus nonempty joint activation; requested flags alone do not prove the intervention ran.

Test normalized source-residue preservation including X, insertion-heavy/fragments/duplicates, hand-checkable repaired-column weights and effective counts, finite native scores/thresholds, policy propagation, serial/spawn agreement, invalid-scope rejection and unchanged constituent/default outputs. Original three CPU libraries must remain byte-identical and must not be rebuilt.

fixed_scientific_settings.initial_search: Authenticated unchanged canonical numeric-hit checkpoint; only downstream profile/graph/candidate/native stages are recomputed.
fixed_scientific_settings.candidate_policy: Unchanged admitted canonical satellite_v2 expansion and membership constraints, with the same fixed parameters and complete ownership.
fixed_scientific_settings.tree_caches: Controls may reuse their exact admitted constituent caches; candidates use canonical cache. Only content-compatible unchanged alignments/trees may be reused, with exact gene/sequence/settings checks. Infer changed species/gene trees and record cache hits/remapping separately from fresh work.

pilot_validation: Freeze and push tested scientific/runner and separately frozen reader sources before submission; bind exact source/runtime/tools/commands, original checkpoint and four admitted constituent golden references in an immutable launch.

Require all four controls to reproduce their original prescribed graph-stage/candidate/constraint equivalence and exact native root-HOG/pair/confidence/rooted-tree products, full universe and official OrthoBench points. Dynamic namespace/timing fields are not biological golden bytes. Any failed control blocks both candidates; never replace it with an old score silently.

All six arms must complete actual activation, native ownership/content and official score readback before panel admission. Execution/scoring failures remain failures, not negative biology or zero activation. Keep failed attempts immutable and use explicit separately bound recovery if needed.

Preserve native membership/pair/confidence changes separately from official accuracy. Benchmark labels and GO/EC/FAS annotations are evaluation-only and cannot affect recruitment, trees, thresholds or runtime decisions.

pilot_advancement.candidate_f1: Strictly greater than every one of its three matched controls, including the stronger solo constituent, not merely greater than canonical.
pilot_advancement.decline_reference: Each of the three declared matched controls independently; all conditions must hold.
pilot_advancement.stopping: One valid pilot per combination. Stop each fixed candidate that fails any original/corresponding constituent gate without retuning or full-dataset extension. If neither passes, close this interaction branch as a bounded informative negative. Do not select only the larger apparent winner if both pass.

uncertainty.unit: Paired resampling of the same70 OrthoBench reference families using the official weighted statistic, never IID predicted gene pairs.
uncertainty.multiplicity: Report paired percentile and Bonferroni-adjusted intervals for18 prespecified contrast/metric comparisons. This within-phase adjustment does not undo campaign-wide development exposure or establish independent confirmation.
uncertainty.gate_scope: Point gates are development screens, not significance/equivalence tests or default-promotion criteria. Do not relax them based on intervals.

full_dataset_followup.when: Only unchanged combinations passing the complete independently admitted pilot.
full_dataset_followup.matched_closure: For each passing combination include canonical, repair-only and its corresponding legacy-weighting constituent. Minimum union is four arms for one passing combination or six for both; failed combinations are never revived as candidates.
full_dataset_followup.controls: Recompute registered graph/candidate/native controls in the full-dataset execution. Exact-compatible tree caches are allowed. Reuse old control assessment only after exact native/candidate/rooted-tree identity and explicit source-bound assessment evidence; never resample FAS to replace an unchanged control.
full_dataset_followup.screen: Require all eight endpoints. Preserve the original canonical screen: at least one primary F1 gain and no endpoint point decline greater than0.005. Additionally require no endpoint point decline greater than0.005 versus either corresponding solo constituent. Preserve pilot eligibility and roles; no per-dataset winners or heterogeneous mean.
full_dataset_followup.limitations: Report precision/recall, full native/reference coverage, eligible and actual numeric functional populations, paired OrthoBench uncertainty and cache/phase-specific costs. Conditional functional means and unseeded FAS are not orthology accuracy. Do not fabricate QfO family or IID pair intervals; TreeFam supporting and Three Kingdoms supplementary.

resources.timing_scope: Shared-host cached downstream replay/assessment/recovery phases, not isolated fresh whole-tool timing or summed RSS.

delivery: Commit/push this protocol before joint implementation/evaluation. Then test, commit, push and freeze code/runner/reader at validated milestones; record exact jobs/manifests and retain negative results. Finish combined comparison/recommendation, final candidate freeze, independent confirmation or documented unavailable data and verified remote audit. This phase remains part of the original goal, not a replacement objective.
